verdict.rationale: cubic offers a CLI that reviews local changes before push and generates a fix prompt for a coding agent, plus an MCP server for agent integration, which supports pre-push local review; runtime probes confirm the CLI installs and works. However, this is CLI-based rather than a native in-IDE review experience, and there's no evidence of a dedicated IDE extension/plugin showing inline review comments as you type. missing for 10: dedicated IDE plugin/extension evidence, independent hands-on validation of CLI catching issues pre-push, editor-integrated inline annotations.
